description: Two sections in 4HP: one picking between two voltages by size, and one doing arithmetic on another two

params.text: Switches the integer and fraction outputs between keeping the sign of C and reporting both as positive

inputs.text: One of the two voltages the upper section weighs against each other; an empty jack reads 0V
The first voltage of the arithmetic section; with the jack empty it reads the A input
The second voltage of the arithmetic section; with the jack empty it reads the B input

outputs.text: Carries whichever of the two upper voltages is the lower
Carries whichever of the two upper voltages is the higher
Carries whichever of the two upper voltages is closer to 0V, positive or negative
Carries whichever of the two upper voltages is further from 0V, positive or negative
Carries the distance between the two upper voltages, always positive
Carries the two upper voltages added together and halved
Carries the whole-volt part of C, with the fraction discarded
Carries the part of C below a whole volt, with the whole volts discarded
Carries C and D added together
Carries C divided by D, holding its last value when D is too near zero unless the menu says to give 0V
Carries D divided by C, holding its last value when C is too near zero unless the menu says to give 0V

notes: multiplication and division can run far past the usual voltage range, and the outputs are clamped to -12V to 12V until you widen or turn off the clipping range
menu: Div-by-zero mode: Keep last value, Output 0V — chooses what a division output does when its divisor is within a millionth of a volt of zero
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed

inputs.2:
polyphonic

unpatched it reads the A input.
inputs.3:
polyphonic
